verdict.rationale: Kong provides Konnect admin APIs to list/manage AI Gateways (docs-14) and a kongctl CLI supporting declarative-as-code and imperative commands (docs-41), plus AI Auth Strategy and AI Vault entities for key/credential management (docs-22, docs-23, docs-38, docs-39) and cost/budget-related metrics (docs-18, docs-33). However, there is no explicit documentation of a full programmatic API for provisioning budgets/spend limits (only rate-limiting plugins and cost tracking are shown, not a budget-creation API endpoint), and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, so the admin API surface for full gateway/key/budget provisioning isn't independently confirmed. missing for 10: a documented API/CLI endpoint specifically for creating or setting budgets/spend caps, a discoverable OpenAPI spec confirming the full admin API surface, and independent/hands-on confirmation of end-to-end programmatic provisioning.
